verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair question for a developer-facing API product with SDKs, a CLI and an embedded verification flow, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out for Stripe Identity or its tooling. The community concerns about data storage are about how ID documents are secured, not telemetry, so they do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
